design_basis.component_origin: The stored NOAA CO2 source review identified a page-versus-raw-table value difference for 2023 and recorded the raw-only adapter as NOT_RUN. The component compares those source surfaces while preserving both values and their source digests.
design_basis.c1_rule_applied: Compare same-task ability, evidence completeness, coverage, real cost, reliability, maintainability, risk, and rollback. Retire only when the replacement covers every valuable use; otherwise preserve distinct value or uncertainty.

claim_ceiling: Provider-reported annual CO2 growth and stated uncertainty values on two fixed NOAA GML surfaces at capture time, with exact arithmetic differences only.
